methods.name: contact_count
methods.description: Get the number of contacts associated with this thermal wall. If the optional keyword argument type is given, the count is limited to the contact types specified. The optional type keyword argument should be a Python type object (one of: itasca.BallBallThermalContact, itasca.BallPebbleThermalContact, itasca.PebblePebbleThermalContact, itasca.BallFacetThermalContact or itasca.PebbleFacetThermalContact). If the optional keyword argument all is True the count includes virtual contacts.

methods.name: contacts
methods.signature: thermalwall.contacts([piece, ]all=False, type=None) -> tuple of Contact objects
methods.description: Get a tuple of contacts associated with this wall. An optional argument can be included which is a piece object (a thermal ball, a thermal pebble or a thermal facet). If the optional keyword argument type is given, the returned list is limited to the contact types specified. The type keyword argument should be a Python type object (one of: itasca.BallBallThermalContact, itasca.BallPebbleThermalContact, itasca.PebblePebbleThermalContact, itasca.BallFacetThermalContact or itasca.PebbleFacetThermalContact). If the (optional) keyword argument all is True the returned list includes virtual contacts.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: thermalwall.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> int
methods.description: Remove from the given group from the thermal wall. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is an integer which is the first slot in which the group name was found or -1 if not found.

methods.description: Test if the thermal wall is part of a given group. All group slots are searched.
